name: psram_lvgl
title: LVGL touch demo
description: LVGL v9 running as a PSRAM app: 400x240 canvas scaled 2x, GT911 touch, exit with the physical X button.
author: LVGL; P4 port by giltal
about: A small LVGL v9 app with touch widgets, drawn on a 400x240 canvas and scaled 2x. A quick way to check that the display, touch and the PAPP loader work.
controls: Touch: tap and drag the widgets
Slider: sets the bar and dial
Switch: pause / resume the live graph
Paddle wheel: drives the gauge and graph
